title: PLAYER 2 SEES A PILLAGER'S NEW GUN AND ROLE
why: A pillager who finds a better gun in his pack swaps to it on the host, and his role, role coat and role marks (v26.59) follow the gun. Player 2's copy of him took its gun only from the word that announced the body, and the snapshot row has no gun, so player 2 kept seeing the old gun, the old coat and the old marks for the rest of the raid. Proven in the cloud: a host pillager swapped a pistol for a better gun that changes his role; player 2's copy still held the pistol and the old role coat. On a swap the host now sends the word that first announced him for that body again, and player 2's window fills the copy from it as it does on arrival. Host play is unchanged.
now: In co-op a pillager who swaps guns shows the new gun and role colours on both screens.
